You are working on the Zeus project - a clean, production-ready refactoring of the asterion MCP Mesh SDK Web Interface.

## Project Mission
Transform asterion into a maintainable, diogenes-compatible system while preserving 100% of original functionality.

## Core Architecture Principles

### 1. Diogenes Compatibility First
- **Pattern Matching**: Mirror diogenes architectural patterns exactly
- **Visual Consistency**: Match diogenes UI/UX design language
- **Integration Ready**: Design for future absorption into diogenes ecosystem
- **Theme Compatibility**: Support all diogenes themes without modification

### 2. Clean Code Standards
- **Language Purity**: JavaScript only (no TypeScript mixing)
- **English Only**: All comments, strings, documentation in English
- **Configuration Driven**: No hardcoded values, everything configurable
- **Modular Design**: Clear separation of concerns across directories

### 3. Quality First
- **Comprehensive Testing**: Manual and integration testing required
- **Error Handling**: Graceful error management throughout
- **Performance**: Maintain or improve asterion response times
- **Documentation**: Complete documentation following templates

## Technology Stack

**Backend**: Node.js + Express.js (diogenes-compatible patterns)
**Templates**: HyperAxe (matching diogenes exactly)
**Configuration**: JSON-based with feature flags
**Themes**: CSS using diogenes color variables
**Client**: Progressive enhancement with minimal JavaScript

## Directory Structure Standards

```
zeus/
├── backend/        # Application logic (handlers, services)
├── server/         # Infrastructure (routing, middleware)
├── client/assets/  # Static files (CSS, JS, images, themes)
├── configs/        # Configuration management
├── models/         # Data models and business logic
├── views/          # HyperAxe templates and components
└── PLANIFICACION/  # Project management and documentation
```

## Development Workflow

### Agent-Based Development
- **Specialized Agents**: Backend, Frontend, Configuration, Integration, Validation
- **Sprint System**: Request-based micro-sprints with checkpoint tracking
- **Documentation**: Complete iteration documentation required
- **Quality Gates**: Validation agent approval required for completion

### Code Review Requirements
- **Technical Standards**: JavaScript purity, English comments, diogenes patterns
- **Documentation**: Complete work logs and technical decision documentation
- **Integration**: Diogenes compatibility verified
- **Process**: Checkpoint accuracy and handoff completeness

## Feature Requirements

### Preserved from Asterion
- **AI Conversations**: Chat interface with conversation history
- **Preset Library**: Preset creation, management, and activation
- **MCP Explorer**: Server browsing and tool discovery (renamed to "Editor")
- **Settings Management**: Theme switching, configuration management  
- **Statistics Dashboard**: Usage metrics and system status

### Enhanced for Diogenes Integration
- **Theme System**: Full diogenes theme compatibility
- **Navigation**: Diogenes-style navigation with emoji + text
- **Configuration**: Diogenes-compatible config management
- **i18n Support**: Internationalization following diogenes patterns
- **API Compatibility**: REST endpoints compatible with diogenes conventions

## Quality Standards

### Code Quality
- All functions documented with clear English comments
- No Spanish text anywhere in codebase
- Configuration externalized (no magic numbers or hardcoded URLs)
- Comprehensive error handling with user-friendly messages
- Performance-conscious implementation (no blocking operations)

### Integration Quality  
- Visual consistency with diogenes themes and navigation
- API patterns compatible with diogenes endpoints
- Configuration structure compatible with diogenes
- Seamless future integration capability

### Documentation Quality
- Sprint iterations documented following exact template structure
- All technical decisions justified and documented
- Complete work logs with file changes and outcomes
- Clear handoff information for subsequent agents
